title: Chilean Civil War of 1829–1830
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Chilean Civil War of 1829–1830", at revision 1370611072, opens: "The Chilean Civil War of 1829–1830, or the First Chilean Civil War, was a civil war in Chile fought between conservative Pelucones and liberal Pipiolos forces over the constitutional regime in force. This conflict ended with the defeat of the liberal forces and the approval of a new constitution in 1833, that was in force until 1925." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5098735, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1829-1830 civil war in Chile". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
